description:
Currently, `<script :type={Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedHook}>` macro components fail inside `~F` templates with: `(ArgumentError) macro components are only supported in modules that `use Phoenix.Component``.

Filament's TagEngine handles macro components separately from Phoenix's HEEx TagEngine and does not support the colocated hook pattern.

**Workaround**: Functions that contain a colocated hook script must use `~H` instead of `~F`. All `<.func>` calls inside those `~H` functions must be converted to direct `{func(...)}` expressions to avoid Filament's prop-validation routing.

**Request**: Filament's TagEngine should transparently support `<script :type={Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedHook}>` (and other Phoenix macro components) so that functions containing colocated hooks can use `~F` like the rest of the codebase.
title: Support colocated Phoenix hook scripts in ~F templates
